hints.title: Count Student Preferences
hints.text: Count how many students prefer circular sandwiches (0) and square sandwiches (1).

hints.title: Consume Top Sandwich
hints.text: The sandwich stack cannot be reordered. Students take the top sandwich if any student wants it.

hints.title: Stop When No Match Remains
hints.text: If the top sandwich type has zero remaining interested students, circulation stops and remaining students cannot eat.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is number of students / sandwiches
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full queue rotation simulation takes O(n^2) worst case.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting student preferences solves the problem in O(n) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies that queue order is irrelevant and only sandwich stack order matters.
